about: A pillar of leadership within her legal community, Cheryl Stein has made it her mission to help her clients navigate their tumultuous family law matters without adding any undue stress while simultaneously building them up for success in their futures. At Law & Mediation Offices of Cheryl Stein in New York City, New York, she handles a wide variety of family law issues, including:

Ms. Stein made her first foray into the legal field through her enrollment in the Fordham University School of Law, where she was actively involved in the Family Law Clinic and the Legal Services of New York. She received her Juris Doctor with honors in 2005 and practices law and mediation in New York. She is a skilled and experienced mediator, with additional mediation certifications.

Within her legal community, Ms. Stein strives to progress the standard of client care in her industry to greater heights through her own practice, emphasizing personalized attention, meticulous focus and compassionate care and support. She maintains close affiliations with myriad legal organizations, including the New York State Bar Association, the New York City Bar Association, the New York State Council on Divorce Mediation, the New York County Lawyers Association and the Academy of Professional Family Mediators, among many others.
